text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app (`create-next-app` completed), installed all three CopilotKit packages (775 packages added), and wrote all the required files exactly per the quickstart: the API route (`app/api/copilotkit/route.ts`), the provider-wrapped layout (`app/layout.tsx`), and the page with `CopilotSidebar` (`app/page.tsx`). TypeScript type-checking (`tsc --noEmit`) passed cleanly with exit code 0. However, I was blocked because no real `OPENAI_API_KEY` was present in the sandbox environment, so I had to use a placeholder. The `next build` process was killed (likely OOM), and while `next dev` printed "Ready in 331ms" and began compiling `/api/copilotkit`, the server never actually listened on port 3000—curl and `ss` both showed connection refused—so I could not verify a working copilot endpoint.
